title: Ai Iijima Interactive Video Clip: Good Island Cafe
native_title: 飯島愛 ～グッド・アイランド・カフェ
overview:
Good Island Cafe is an interactive video clip disc starring Japanese media personality Ai Iijima. Use the footage on the disc to put together your own black-and-white music video clips, watch Ai perform her songs, and sit in on an interview with her.

- Music video creation for one player
- Shuttle Mouse compatible
